packet_identity.title: Targeted primary-source research packet C
packet_identity.optional_kenya_drone_exclusion_reason: Four stronger bounded industrial-facility tasks were completed; no directly official Kenya field-service source was added without displacing a stronger task.

rules: Facility identity or presence is not qualified capability.
A product catalogue is not facility-qualified recurring throughput.
Nameplate, installed, cumulative, or reported capacity is not effective available capacity.
Accreditation or stated service scope is not proof of every test, uncertainty range, availability, or throughput.
Payload development, fabrication, environmental testing, or calibration capability is not production capacity.
UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN; no canonical promotion is made from this packet.

source_rights_posture: Public official sources only; this report stores URLs, metadata, scoped paraphrases, and locators, not reproduced source text.

sources.scoped_paraphrase: ELGi Sauer states that it expanded operations by opening a 50,000 sq ft Kallappalayam, Coimbatore facility with INR400m investment. The stated scope is high-pressure compressors, pressure-reducing stations, portable breathing-air compressors, engineering support, new-product development, and prototype testing.
sources.identity_geography: ELGi Sauer manufacturing/engineering facility; Kallappalayam, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India.
sources.facility_product_process_state: Facility and stated product/process scope reported as opened/expanded in 2023; present output and qualification state not independently established.
sources.capacity_semantics: 50,000 sq ft is footprint and INR400m is investment; neither is throughput. Effective qualified recurring throughput is UNKNOWN.
sources.caveats: The release says the facility would begin manufacturing; it gives no plant output, utilization, yield, qualification, or current availability.
sources.mapped_gap: Verify current operation, product-line qualification, process capability, and effective recurring compressor throughput.

sources.scoped_paraphrase: ELGi describes a foundry, a 100+ acre Air Compressor Plant at Kinathukadavu near Coimbatore, a pressure-vessel division, compressor assembly, machine-building, metrology, and test equipment. It reports 9,000 metric tons/year installed foundry capacity, 2,400 pressure vessels/month manufacturing capacity, and rotor/profile-grinding capability.
sources.identity_geography: ELGi foundry, Air Compressor Plant, and pressure-vessel/manufacturing operations; Kinathukadavu near Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India.
sources.facility_product_process_state: Company manufacturing operations and process scope are described on the official page; current line-by-line operating and qualification state is not independently established.
sources.capacity_semantics: 9,000 metric tons/year and 2,400 vessels/month are reported installed/manufacturing claims; they are not effective qualified throughput and are not allocated to a validated product mix.
sources.caveats: Page date and measurement basis are unspecified; no utilization, yield, product allocation, calibration traceability, or customer qualification is supplied.
sources.mapped_gap: Plant-level capability matrix linking compressors, pressure vessels, foundry, machining, metrology, qualification, yield, and effective throughput.

sources.scoped_paraphrase: Alfa Laval India states that its Maharashtra factories manufacture and supply key components and systems in separation, heat transfer, and flow technology, with manufacturing units located in Pune and Satara.
sources.identity_geography: Alfa Laval India manufacturing units; Pune and Satara, Maharashtra, India.
sources.facility_product_process_state: Reported manufacturing/supply scope covers separation, heat-transfer, and flow components/systems; product-to-site mapping and current operating state are not independently established.
sources.capacity_semantics: No facility throughput, installed capacity, qualification, utilization, or effective capacity is reported; effective qualified throughput is UNKNOWN.
sources.caveats: The page does not establish that every listed product family is made at both named locations.
sources.mapped_gap: Map specific heat-exchanger families to Pune/Satara lines and obtain qualification, process, capacity, and availability evidence.

sources.locator: product-family sections and design-envelope paragraph, page lines 3-69
sources.scoped_paraphrase: The plate-heat-exchanger portfolio lists brazed, fusion-bonded, gas-to-liquid, gasketed, semi-welded, welded, spiral, plate-and-block, plate-and-shell, and printed-circuit families; the page describes selection/design use and an envelope up to 100 bar and 450 C.
sources.identity_geography: Alfa Laval plate-heat-exchanger product portfolio; India-facing product page, facility geography not specified.
sources.facility_product_process_state: Product catalogue scope only; no facility, production-line, process-qualification, or operating-state claim is made by this source.
sources.capacity_semantics: 100 bar and 450 C are catalogue design-envelope values, not manufacturing throughput or qualified recurring capacity.
sources.caveats: Catalogue scope must not be used to infer Pune/Satara manufacture, customer qualification, or available supply.
sources.mapped_gap: Facility-level make/qualification and effective throughput by heat-exchanger subtype, materials, joining, testing, and duty.

sources.publisher: STQC, Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology, Government of India
sources.rights_posture: public official government webpage; link-only paraphrase
sources.scoped_paraphrase: STQC describes its Electronics Regional Test Laboratories as NABL-accredited test and calibration laboratories. ERTL North New Delhi is described for high-precision calibration, environmental, power/energy, and EMI/EMC work; ERTL East Kolkata for opto-electronics, mining electronics, mobile calibration, environmental, and safety work. The page also lists Mumbai and Thiruvananthapuram specializations.
sources.identity_geography: STQC ERTL network; North New Delhi and East Kolkata, India (with additional official locations listed on the page).
sources.facility_product_process_state: Government laboratory network with reported NABL-accredited test/calibration service scope; exact current certificate scope for a requested instrument or process must be checked.
sources.capacity_semantics: Accreditation and service scope do not establish throughput, turnaround, uncertainty for a specific measurement, or available slots; effective service capacity is UNKNOWN.
sources.caveats: Accreditation is scope- and method-specific; the source does not provide line capacity, queue time, equipment availability, or product qualification outcomes.
sources.mapped_gap: Obtain current NABL scopes, uncertainty/range, traceability, equipment, turnaround, and precision-manufacturing test availability for each ERTL site.

sources.scoped_paraphrase: NEI states that it has four manufacturing plants at Jaipur, Newai, Bagru, and Vadodara/Savli, and describes world-class manufacturing/process technology and automated/process discipline. The page gives plant area figures but no plant-level production allocation.

sources.facility_product_process_state: Reported operating manufacturing network with bearing process/manufacturing scope; precise bearing-family, machine, qualification, and line-state mapping remains unverified.
sources.capacity_semantics: Plant area is facility footprint, not throughput. Effective qualified recurring throughput by plant and product is UNKNOWN.
sources.caveats: The source does not allocate product families, utilization, yield, qualification, or available capacity to individual plants.
sources.mapped_gap: Plant-specific bearing family/process map with machine, metrology, qualification, yield, utilization, and effective throughput evidence.

sources.scoped_paraphrase: NBC describes deep-groove ball, taper-roller, spherical-roller, cylindrical-roller, needle, railway axle-box, and special bearing products. It reports manufacturing over 200 million bearings/year in more than 2,300 variants for automotive, railway, aerospace, and industrial applications.
sources.identity_geography: NBC/NEI bearing manufacturer and product range; corporate page associated with Jaipur, India, with manufacturing network described separately.
sources.facility_product_process_state: Product and corporate manufacturing claim; plant allocation, process route, qualification, and current operating state for any particular variant are not established.
sources.capacity_semantics: Over 200 million bearings/year is a corporate reported production claim with no plant, mix, uptime, yield, or qualification basis; it is not effective available throughput for a specified bearing.
sources.caveats: Variant count and annual figure cannot be converted to per-plant or product-specific supply without allocation and evidence.
sources.mapped_gap: Variant-level qualified production, process windows, quality/yield, plant allocation, and current available supply.

canonical_reconciliation.unresolved_mapping_policy: Hold all candidates as evidence-linked staging records until identity, geography, operating state, capability, qualification, and capacity checks pass.

blockers: Facility presence or an official manufacturing description does not establish qualified capability or effective available throughput.
Reported installed/nameplate, footprint, investment, historical cumulative output, and corporate annual output must not be substituted for effective qualified capacity.
Alfa Laval product catalogue scope is not proof that every heat-exchanger subtype is made at Pune or Satara or is currently available.
STQC accreditation and stated ERTL service scope require method-specific certificate, uncertainty, traceability, queue, and availability checks.
ISRO payload-development, environmental-test, and calibration scope does not establish payload production cadence or current qualification for a specified instrument.
Current dates, product-to-line allocation, process windows, yield, utilization, qualification, and capacity remain missing for most candidates.
Kenya drone field-service was not added because the bounded four-task packet was complete without a directly official source displacing stronger industrial evidence.
No canonical facility, capability, product, process, or location promotion was authorized or performed.
